briefing.headline: OpenAI o3 and DeepSeek-R2 accelerate multi-agent systems as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with new model releases and massive infrastructure bets. US-China tensions escalate over export controls while safety concerns mount.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o3 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4; DeepSeek-R2 matches GPT-5 performance at lower cost; Meta open-sources Llama 4.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell in volume; xAI activates 200k H100 Memphis cluster; Google expands Stargate data centers with TPU v6.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the gap with closed labs before 2027 regulatory deadlines?
